headline: B200 rises +6% on the week while H200 falls -10%, both driven by marketplace moves.
bullets: B200's market index reached $8.60, up +6% over 7 days, with marketplace up +13% and neocloud up +6% while hyperscaler held at +0%.
H200's market index fell -10% to $5.40, driven entirely by the marketplace segment (-10%), while hyperscaler and neocloud were unchanged at +0%.
H100 SXM held at $4.62 with every segment at +0%, yet its hyperscaler median of $10.68 still runs +140% above the neocloud median of $4.45.
Across all 11 tracked GPUs, H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour, and H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%.
Among the headline GPUs, Vast.ai is the cheapest provider for H100 SXM at $1.74 and for A100 80GB SXM at $1.17, and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest for B200 at $5.98.
watch: Watch whether B200 marketplace strength (+13%) spreads to the hyperscaler segment, and whether the H200 marketplace decline (-10%) reaches the neocloud segment.
